title: Jurisdiction pack (E-19): one cited rule for one job class in one jurisdiction

jurisdiction.description: Slash path from the broadest level, e.g. STATE/COUNTY/CITY. The job supplies its own chain; nothing is geocoded or inferred.

rule.description: The rule as found, in plain words.

source.description: URL or citation. SYNTHETIC-FIXTURE for sample packs.

credential_required.description: Specific credential ids (E-18). [] = the pack affirmatively finds no credential required. null = the pack could not determine it => UNKNOWN.

threshold.description: The rule applies only when job.scope[field] satisfies the comparison. If the job lacks the field => UNKNOWN.

sample.description: true = SYNTHETIC fixture; asserts no legal fact; results are never authoritative.
